config.dynamicoutlines.title: Dynamic Outlines
config.dynamicoutlines.missing_tool_visi:
Controls the outline when breaking the block wouldn't give you anything.

Always Show:
Always shows the non-interactive outline color, even when you're holding the wrong tool (or no tool at all) for the block you're looking at.

Always Hide:
Hides the outline whenever you're holding the wrong tool for the block, even if you're holding something you could otherwise place against it.

Hide Unless Placing:
Hides the outline when you're missing the correct tool, unless you're holding something placeable that you could set down against it.
config.dynamicoutlines.show_outline_when: When enabled, the outline always shows regardless of whether placement would succeed.
config.dynamicoutlines.currently_breakin: When disabled, a block keeps its normal outline color and visibility even while you're actively breaking it.
config.dynamicoutlines.stroke_width.tool: Controls how thick block and entity outlines are drawn.
config.dynamicoutlines.outline_alpha.too: Global transparency for all block and entity outlines.
When disabled, outlines always render at full brightness regardless of lighting.
config.dynamicoutlines.outline_invisible: When enabled, invisible entities can still be outlined like any other entity.
config.dynamicoutlines.interactive_color: Outline color used for any interactive block.
config.dynamicoutlines.noninteractive_co: Outline color used for ordinary blocks.
config.dynamicoutlines.entity_color.tool: Outline color used when targeting a passive or neutral entity.
config.dynamicoutlines.enemy_color.toolt: Outline color used when targeting a hostile entity.
config.dynamicoutlines.entity_interactio: Overrides an entity's outline color when you're holding an item that unlocks a special interaction with it.
